context: Tests whether the agent respects the generate-tasks rule's two-phase interaction model: parent tasks generated from PRD analysis, explicit pause with the documented confirmation question, and production of sub-tasks or the final task-list file only after user confirmation.

checklist.name: Phase 1 artifact exists
checklist.description: phase1-parent-tasks.md exists in the working directory.

checklist.name: Parent tasks derived from the PRD
checklist.description: The parent tasks trace back to the PRD's functional requirements and user stories (matching invoice upload, matcher, reconciliation/reporting), not generic boilerplate.

checklist.name: Reasonable parent granularity
checklist.description: The parent list is a small number of high-level tasks (roughly five), each a phase or component rather than a line-level step.

checklist.name: Parent tasks as checklist items
checklist.description: Parent tasks use the '- [ ] N.0 Title' checkbox convention of the rule's output format (or an equivalent pending-checkable list).

checklist.name: Confirmation question quoted
checklist.description: The file contains the documented pause prompt ('I have generated the high-level tasks based on the PRD. Ready to generate the sub-tasks? Respond with 'Go' to proceed.') verbatim or near-verbatim.

checklist.name: No sub-tasks generated
checklist.description: The artifact contains no sub-task breakdowns (no 'N.1', 'N.2' items); Phase 2 was not started.

checklist.name: Final task-list file not created
checklist.description: tasks/tasks-prd-invoice-matching.md does not exist; generation stopped at Phase 1.

checklist.name: PRD not modified
checklist.description: tasks/prd-invoice-matching.md is unchanged; the agent read it but did not rewrite it.
